scope: Keep selected layout and typography; replace plum with teal and soften supporting color.

prompts.prompt:
Edit the attached HackJudge "Competition broadcast" concept board. Keep its two-view layout, all content, exact typography character and hierarchy, scale, component positions, icons, spacing, project rows, timetable, and zero-project/first-submissions states unchanged. This is a color exploration ONLY. Preserve the confident competition theme, large condensed lettering and block composition. No new content or facts, no additional shapes, no gradients/glow/texture. Replace plum primary with a BLUE-LEANING TEAL primary. Dial down the supporting palette just a touch: reduce saturation and harsh contrast between the colored challenge bands, while maintaining excellent readable text contrast and a clearly visible primary action. Never use mint-green pastel medical branding, soft bubbly type or a teal-lime healthcare palette. Deep teal should feel like a mature competition platform. Board title changes to the specified title, small "Color study · Sample event details" caption. Only colors and title change.
Title "A / Teal + softened color". Recommended balanced rendition. Main page/board background deep PETROL TEAL #173F46, panels a slightly lighter #214C53, light text warm offwhite #F5F3EA. Header/schedule/footer warm white #F5F3EA with dark teal text. Challenge bands are muted warm straw #D8C788, soft blue-gray #BBCBD0, and muted warm clay #D7B0A1. All three have deep teal text. Primary button and active timeline segment use warm straw #D8C788 with deep teal labels. Icons and rules change from purple to deep teal. Secondary outline button has ivory border/label. Preserve the original three distinct track blocks, but make the whole palette feel coordinated and less loud.
